basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school senior from Austin, Texas, trying to make the most of my last year before college. I love playing video games, especially Street Fighter V, and I'm a big fan of AOC. My interests also include cryptography and tech innovations, which I explore in my free time. I'm usually online in the evenings, after school and homework. As I prepare for college, I'm juggling part-time work at a local café. I'm single and enjoying the freedom that comes with it.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a budding interest in technology and politics, mostly self-taught through online resources and forums. My fascination with cryptography started after a high school project, which led me to explore subreddits like nucypher. I also follow political discussions to better understand current events and social issues.
